# Lazarus Deal Recovery

> Lazarus Deal Recovery is B2B pipeline and deal recovery software for sales managers and VPs of Sales. It identifies which stalled and closed-lost deals are still recoverable versus a flat no, why momentum died, and what to do in the next 0-90 days. Human-led, AI-assisted. Not an AI SDR, autonomous closer, or meeting bot.

Lazarus reads a recording, transcript, email thread, and optional HubSpot or Salesforce notes. It names the blocker and returns a CRM-ready brief you paste into forecast notes. Five free analyses a month; paid plans are priced per deal analysis, not per seat. After a monthly cap you wait until next month, or buy a $10 extra report. Keep Meet, Teams, or Zoom — Lazarus never joins the call.

Official site: https://www.getldr.ca/

## Product

- Category: BusinessApplication / sales deal recovery
- Buyer: Frontline sales manager or VP of Sales who owns the forecast call
- Outcome: Closable vs blocked, recoverable vs flat no, blocker, 0-90 day plan
- CRM: Optional HubSpot or Salesforce OAuth for notes; write-back is human-confirmed paste
- Meetings: Zoom, Google Meet, Microsoft Teams stay yours. Lazarus does not join or record the live call as a bot

## Why not ChatGPT

ChatGPT writes. Paste the same call twice and the answer can change. Lazarus reads the text, checks quotes against the transcript, then scores with fixed rules a manager can defend in the room. If a quote or person is not in the upload, the server strips it before the score runs.
